raw.details:
Overview

Build. Innovate. Secure the Future.

Chandigarh University, in collaboration with the Indian Institute of Technology (IIT) Guwahati, proudly presents CodeFort 2027, a national-level 24-hour hackathon under the Information Security Education and Awareness (ISEA) Project Phase III, supported by the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY), Government of India.

Scheduled for 5–6 February 2027 at Chandigarh University, Mohali, Punjab, CodeFort 2027 aims to bring together innovative minds, technology enthusiasts, developers, and problem-solvers to address emerging cybersecurity challenges.

Theme: SECURITY IN DISTRIBUTED WIRELESS NETWORKS

The hackathon focuses on developing innovative solutions in:

  • Internet of Things (IoT) Security
  • Distributed Wireless Network Security
  • Secure Connected Systems
  • Cybersecurity Innovation
  • Emerging Security Challenges in Connected Devices

What to expect?

  • 24-hour intensive hackathon experience.
  • Hands-on development of innovative cybersecurity solutions.
  • Technical mentorship and expert guidance.
  • Project demonstrations and evaluation by an expert jury.
  • Opportunity to showcase technical creativity and problem-solving skills.
  • Recognition of outstanding projects through final presentations and prize distribution.

Event Schedule

5 February 2027

  • Registration and inauguration
  • Welcome address and problem statement release
  • Hackathon commencement
  • Development sessions and mentor checkpoints

6 February 2027

  • Continued development
  • Final project submission
  • Project demonstrations and expert evaluation
  • Final presentations
  • Valedictory ceremony and prize distribution

Why participate?

CodeFort 2027 provides a platform to transform innovative ideas into practical cybersecurity solutions. Participants will get an opportunity to demonstrate their technical expertise, collaborate with fellow innovators, interact with experts, and contribute to building safer and more secure connected systems.

Event Details

  • Event: CodeFort 2027
  • Dates: 5–6 February 2027
  • Mode: Offline
  • Venue: Chandigarh University, Mohali, Punjab, India
  • Collaborating Institution: IIT Guwahati
  • Initiative: ISEA Project Phase III
  • Funding Support: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY), Government of India

Be a part of CodeFort 2027. Innovate with purpose. Build with security. Shape the future!
